C0221.title: Guangzhou Police Dismantle New-Type Fraud Gang Exploiting E-Commerce Promotions
C0221.summary: In August 2021, the Haizhu District Public Security Bureau in Guangzhou received a report from an e-commerce platform alleging that individuals were maliciously using virtual mobile numbers to register multiple accounts, repeatedly claiming platform coupons, and purchasing goods to profit from the price difference, causing a loss of approximately 700,000 yuan.
